value.rationale: A concrete sharp if-and-only-if theorem for all positive branched power exponents distinguishes pointwise synchronization from any continuous local synchronization, even for surjective maps with a path-connected equality fibre product. For the canonical degree-two/degree-three representative it upgrades the primary work’s lower bound to exact strict infinity and demonstrates a branch-order obstruction unseen by homotopy-invariant complexity. This is a structural boundary for the precise invariant, not a parameter tweak or cheap normalization test.
